thread:
marie_cs: quick heads up — Greenline asked if we can add their custom RAG+generator (fine-tuned small-13b) into their Dedicated tenant. They need PHI redaction, custom evals, and a plan for drift monitoring. Can eng + security advise on blockers?

eli_csm: putting the customer ask here — timeline: they'd like a pilot in ~3 weeks. renewal conversation in 6 weeks so this impacts renewal health. They're worried about data residency and audit logs.

david_ml: thanks. a few clarifying q's: 1) do they have a representative eval set (prompts + expected outputs)? 2) model artifact format (hf, ggml, safetensors)? 3) are they expecting us to host the model or bring-your-own to their dedicated pool?

marie_cs: they sent a small eval set (redacted) and the artifact is in safetensors. prefer us to host in their dedicated pool — they'll need isolation and lower latency. I'll drop the sample in the ticket.

anita_security: checklist: KMS for keying, network egress restrictions, PHI redaction pipeline pre-inference, PII detection post-gen, longest retention <= 30d by default, audit logs enabled. Also need an ingestion agreement (DPA addendum). We need to validate that the fine-tuning data scope is documented.

david_ml: technical notes / quick config draft: 
```
model: greenline/finetuned-small-13b
deployment: dedicated-pool-greenline
quant: q4_0 (optional)
preprocessing: phi_redact_v2 -> tokenizer
postprocess: pii_detector_v1 -> redact
logging: tokens=no, metadata=yes
```
Would like to run a safety eval (toxicity, hallucination, PHI leakage) and a latency profil e. Can CS deliver 200 representative queries + 50 adversarial probes?

marie_cs: yes — greenline agreed to provide 300 queries and 30 adversarial examples. Uploading via S3 link.

eli_csm: note for renewal: customer success flag = medium risk if we miss pilot. I'll prepare a playbook for the pilot and upsell talking points if pilot healthy.

ops_bot: ticket CREATED: CS-4397 -> model-intake-greenline, assigned to @david_ml, priority=high

sophia_pm: what's our fail-open policy for dedicated? if model fails safety checks do we fallback to a base model (e.g., open-13b) or block calls? Need decision for canary.

anita_security: must block outputs that contain PHI. fallback to base model that has passed the same redaction + eval pipeline. Also require canary traffic <1% to start + escalation path.

david_ml: plan: 1) run eval suite locally (safety + accuracy) 2) run small canary on dedicated with prefix caching disabled 3) monitor hallucination + PHI alerts for 48h 4) either promote or rollback. I'll post results in this thread.

marie_cs: thanks all — I'll sync with Greenline on the DPA addendum and get the eval S3 link to @david_ml. tagging @eli_csm for renewal notes. :white_check_mark:

eli_csm: will follow up with renewal team and schedule a pre-pilot enablement call with Greenline next Tue.

david_ml: starting eval now, should have preliminary safety numbers in ~24h.

marie_cs: awesome — appreciate the quick turn.
